title: Tenma Tsukasa — Never Give Up〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream

rows.Line: Workshop Venue

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: We only have a few days left together, so I hope you all make the most of our remaining time by learning as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & the Actors
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Now, let's put the sword-fighting exercises you did earlier into practice by using them in a scene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “*Roar*”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line:
“Ah, you've some skill...
I remember when you were just a pipsqueak.”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line:
“Unfortunately...
It's no use...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Urgh...! Grr...!”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: “What happened? You seemed so confident a second ago.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“...!
I cannot lose... Not to the likes of you!”

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Mr. Pegasus...
You misunderstand what your character is feeling.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Yes, it's natural for one to raise their voice during a scene such as this...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: But “you” already know that victory will not be achievable at this rate. You must not forget that grief and despair linger in the back of your mind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please, allow me to try that again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry to bother you during your break!

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: No problem, Pegasus. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, um... Would you mind practicing with me for a bit? I'd like to work on what the director just said.

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds fun!
Lemme join too, Pegasus!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, excellent! Thank you very much! But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you all need to call me by that name...?

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Huh? I think it's cute.
Pegasus seems like a great nickname.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't feel happy about that at all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How did this happen...?
I didn't even do my usual “Tenma, written as 'soaring pegasus'” bit! Why am I being called “Pegasus” by everyone now?!

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Don't ask me. Also, you have your own catchphrase? You're just a gift that keeps on giving, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is this some sort of penalty for not being able to immediately produce results? Is that why I wasn't called by my actual name sooner...?

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Yes, it did take a while for you to be called by your name, but I think he's taken a real liking to you now...

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree.
I mean, he totally cracked up when you introduced yourself.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Once more, you will all be introducing yourselves by playing the same role and reciting the same lines. Please present to me what you are capable of as actors.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Any questions...?
Ah, you there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you! How many versions of “me” am I allowed to present?!

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Uh, Tenma...?
You're not suddenly believing that you have superpowers or something, right...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hehe. In other words, you'd like for me to see a few different renditions of “yourself”, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh! Yes, that's what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: How were we supposed to know?

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: Tenma, we just met, so I'm not sure if I should say this, but have people ever told you that you're pretty weird?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's not...!
Well, yes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unfortunately, the director of my troupe and I have been given the honor of being called the Weirdo Wombo Combo.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hehehe... Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm starting to understand why Genbu told you about this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Now, about your introduction...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: You are all actors, so I'm sure it wasn't easy deciding how you wish to portray yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: However, since you were all so eager to get here, we were able to start early, so who don't you all do two renditions?“

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: Man, you definitely left an impression back there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But my acting was a mess...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm struggling to get an insight into your character's background and self based on your portrayal.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
It tells me nothing about who you are.
Anyway, next...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's right. My acting felt thin that time. It had no depth to it.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (When I perform as a member of Wonderlands×Showtime, I get to do shows based on well-written scripts...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which is why I've had no trouble bringing the characters I play and their stories to life!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It took me quite some time to figure that out and find a solution, but I somehow managed in the end!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Because I was chosen to play the lead as Peter Pan!)

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Look, Pegasus is making weird faces again.

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Hey, Pegasus.
Earth to Pegasus!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! Pardon me. I was deep in thought.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start practicing our parts!

rows.Speaker: Actors A & B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
